notes.title: Update Changes:
notes.notes:
New Boss Added: A winged cockroach boss has been introduced to the game.

Weapon Settings Issue Fixed: The problem where weapon settings were lost after transitioning to the next level has been resolved.

FAQ Page Added: A Frequently Asked Questions section has been added to help guide players.

General Improvements: Various scattered settings and optimizations have been made to improve overall gameplay experience.😁🤝🎉

⚠️ Note: This update may affect your previously saved progress due to changes in game systems. If this happens, I sincerely apologize.

This will likely be the final update, as all known issues have been fixed and I currently do not plan to add further content to the game.

Thank you very much for your support and for being part of this journey.

notes.title: 🔧 Performance Tip – Disable Steam Community In-Game (Overlay)
notes.notes:
**In my tests, I noticed that when Steam Overlay is enabled, the framerate drops to 20 FPS or even lower, but when I disable it, the framerate goes above 140 FPS.**


🔧 Performance Tip – Disable Steam Community In-Game (Overlay)
If you're experiencing unusually low frame rates (FPS) when running the game through Steam, the Steam Overlay may be affecting performance on certain systems.

To improve performance, we recommend disabling the Steam Overlay globally or just for this game.

🛠️ Option 1: Disable Steam Overlay for All Games
Open Steam.

Go to Steam > Settings (top-left corner).

Click on the In-Game tab.

Uncheck the option:
✔ Enable the Steam Overlay while in-game

Click OK to save and restart Steam.

🕹️ Option 2: Disable Steam Overlay for This Game Only
Open Steam and go to your Library.

Right-click on the game and select Properties.

In the General tab, uncheck:
✔ Enable the Steam Overlay while in-game

Disabling the overlay may significantly improve FPS, especially on systems where GPU or driver compatibility issues exist with the Steam In-Game Overlay.

Let us know if you continue to experience performance issues — we're here to help!

notes.title: A pop-up window has been added to confirm save file deletion
notes.notes:
"A pop-up window has been added to confirm save file deletion if you’ve previously played the game and your progress was saved. When you click on 'New Game,' a confirmation pop-up will appear, since starting a new game will erase your previous progress. However, if you wish, you can continue from where you left off by clicking 'Continue.'
Why is progress deleted when starting a new game?
To prevent potential errors during the loading process."

notes.notes:
"In this update, I fixed all the issues I discovered myself or that were reported by players. I spent eight weeks working on optimization, and now the game runs much better. I’ve also added four new and distinct enemy character types along with many other new features.

The vampire worm character was removed from the game because players didn’t like it. One of the key additions in this update is a bug reporting system. With this, you can send your feedback, and a screenshot of the scene will be included to help better understand the reported issue."
[b]"To send feedback, go to the settings menu and press the 'Bug Report button."[/b]
